comments.text: The thing that stuck with me: four of these are homelands with ordinary citizens, and the fifth really isn't. Vatican City was created by treaty in 1929 as a church's seat of government, under half a square kilometre, crossable in about fifteen minutes. San Marino, meanwhile, predates Italy by more than a thousand years. Sources are linked in the description if you want the measurements. What's the smallest border crossing you've made on foot where you live?
